## Active Studio & Ventures
1. **+EV Labs** (https://plusevlabs.com/) — Public parent studio (trading name of LineSensei Ltd) building private AI workflows and client-owned data infrastructure for multi-site enterprises.
2. **Joe Ships** (https://joeships.com/) — Fixed-scope B2B AI solutions and internal tools improving productivity across ordinary commercial businesses in the UK, Australia, and the US.
3. **OddsSensei** (https://oddssensei.com/) — Quantitative pricing software and real-time normalized multi-exchange sports data infrastructure for B2B sports communities and publishers (zero gambling operations or custody of funds).
4. **Chapple Sports** (https://chapplesports.com/) — Strictly separate, independent London football representation practice focused on developing talent, protecting players off the pitch, and creating long-term career opportunities.
